title: Fourier coefficients of product basis functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability law $\pi$, and let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $\Omega$ has a real orthonormal basis indexed by $\iota$ under $\pi$, with one basis vector equal to the constant function $1$. For multi-indices $a,b\in\iota^n$, the Fourier coefficient at $a$ of the product of basis functions indexed coordinatewise by $b$ is $1$ if $a=b$, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$\iota$ is finite, nonempty, and has decidable equality
The basis is indexed by $\iota$ and spans the real-valued functions on $\Omega$
The basis vector at the distinguished index is constant $1$
